thread:
anya: Quick design review—trying to clean up the run trace action affordances in the Playground. Posting screenshots in thread. Main questions: should primary action be a single 'Open run' button or a 'View / Re-run' split? Also copy for the flyout: 'Inspect invocation' vs 'Invocation details' vs 'Run details'. Thoughts?

leo: I vote for a single button to reduce visual noise. 'Open run' is a bit ambiguous though. 'View run' or 'View details' reads clearer. :thinking:

priya: Accessibility: if we keep two actions, the secondary should be in a menu, not two inline buttons—keyboard focus order and screen reader label complexity are the pain points.

samir: From a quick-UX perspective we often want a one-click re-run. Could we do a primary 'View' button and a small icon button for quick 'Re-run' (with a clear tooltip)? Visual: [View] [▶︎] so people can scan.

leo: Copy nit: 'Inspect invocation' feels too technical for the main UI. Our product copy elsewhere uses 'Run' and 'Invocation' inconsistently. Prefer 'View run details' to align.

anya: Good — so tentative consensus: primary 'View run details' + small 'Re-run' icon, with overflow menu for other actions. Priya, can you sketch the keyboard flow? Also how should this behave in compact run-history rows where horizontal space is tight?

priya: In compact mode, collapse actions into an overflow kebab with aria-label='More run actions'. Kebab opens a menu with items: 'View run details', 'Re-run', 'Show call stack', 'Copy invocation id'. Ensure the menu traps focus while open and returns focus to the kebab after close. Use aria-haspopup and aria-expanded on the trigger.

samir: Microcopy for the toast after re-run: current suggestion 'Enqueued run in Playground — check run history.' feels long. Maybe shorten to 'Run started' and link 'View run' inside toast for quick access. For audit we can include 'invocation id' in the toast payload (hidden visually).

leo: Also consider labeling the icon-only button with aria-label='Re-run this invocation' so screen readers get context. Tooltips are not enough for a11y.

anya: UX question: tokens/cost summary — show inline in the flyout or hide behind 'Run details'? I want to avoid token noise for casual users.

leo: Hide cost behind 'Run details' by default. Add 'Show cost' toggle for billing/admin users in settings.

priya: Also add aria-live='polite' region for run status updates in the run list rows so screen readers are notified 'Run completed' or 'Run failed'. Make sure we debounce updates to avoid a flurry of announcements.

anya: Perfect. I'll update the mock (compact + expanded) and push a clickable prototype. Leaving the copy tweaks in a diff below:
- primary button: 'View run details'
- icon button aria-label: 'Re-run this run'
- overflow menu aria-label: 'More run actions'
- toast short copy: 'Run started' + 'View run' link

samir: One extra nit — keyboard shortcut for quick re-run (while focused on a row) could be 'r'. But we should gate it behind a tooltip modal describing shortcuts so it doesn't surprise users.

anya: Noted. I'll prototype the shortcut hint. Thanks all! :sparkles:

ux-bot: Prototype updated by anya: https://figma.redwood/proto/runtrace-actions (preview link).
